---
name: Skill proposal
about: Propose a new lstk skill, agent, or hook. Promoted only on evidence.
title: 'proposal: <name>'
labels: backlog
---

## Workflow

What recurring task does this cover? Describe it in two or three sentences.

## Evidence of recurrence

List at least three real tasks where the workflow came up (dates, repo types, no client names).

## What plain Claude Code lacked

Say what you tried with plain Claude Code and the existing skills first, and what fell short.

## Proposed trigger phrases

What would a user say to start it? Include phrases that must not trigger it.

## Guardrail impact

Does it write files, run commands, or reach the network? Does it weaken any guardrail?

## Promotion criteria

- [ ] The workflow recurred in at least three real tasks (friction log or this issue).
- [ ] Plain Claude Code plus existing skills was tried first, and this issue says what fell short.
- [ ] A trigger eval set and a worked example can be written.
- [ ] It does not weaken a guardrail.
